script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Aleaqmcure Products se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi active hai, 30 din mein poore 30 active days hain, lekin pichhle kuch hafton mein aapke Business Leads mein 50.9% ki girawat aayi hai MoM basis pe — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ek cheez samajhna chahta hoon — jab se yeh lead volume drop hua hai, kya aapko lag raha hai ki buyers jo aa rahe hain woh relevant nahi hain, ya phir aap replies karne ke liye time hi nahi nikal pa rahe? Kyunki last 30 days mein 64 Business Leads aaye hain aur reply rate abhi zero percent hai — toh root cause aapki side se better samajh aayega.
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important data point share karta hoon — aapka CQS score 86 hai, jo actually bahut achha hai, matlab aapka catalog strong hai. Aur PNS success 285.7% pe hai, toh platform pe demand hai. Problem leads ki quantity ya quality nahi, problem sirf engagement gap hai — agar hum yeh 64 unanswered BLs address karein toh conversion window abhi bhi open hai.
script_parts.action: Toh abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka lead inbox open karta hoon aur hum saath milke top 5 unanswered BLs identify karte hain jo most relevant lagte hain, aur main aapko ek quick reply template set karne mein help karta hoon taaki aaj se hi response jaana shuru ho.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, koi bada commitment nahi maang raha — bas yeh 5 replies aaj bhej dijiye, aur 7 din baad main ek short follow-up karoonga dekhne ke liye ki kuch conversations convert hue ya nahi. Theek lagta hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Aleaqmcure Products? This is calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account has been active all 30 days this month, which is great, but your Business Lead volume has dropped 50.9% month-on-month recently, so I wanted to speak with you directly about that.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand something — since this lead volume drop happened, do you feel the buyers coming in aren't relevant to your products, or is it more that you haven't had the bandwidth to reply to them? I ask because 64 Business Leads came in over the last 30 days and the reply rate is currently at zero percent — knowing the real reason will help us fix the right thing.
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's an important data point — your CQS score is 86, which is actually very strong, meaning your catalog quality is solid. And your PNS success rate is at 285.7%, so there is genuine buyer demand on the platform. The issue isn't lead quality or catalog — it's purely an engagement gap, and with 64 unanswered leads, the conversion window is still open if we act now.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your lead inbox and together we'll identify the top 5 most relevant unanswered BLs, and I'll help you set up a quick reply template so responses start going out from today itself.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not asking for any big commitment — just send those 5 replies today, and I'll do a short follow-up in 7 days to check if any conversations converted. Does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
